  • Constructor Details

    • RMIClient

      public RMIClient(String ipAddress, int port, UUID uuid, ClientUI ui, ClientModel model) throws Exception
      Initializes an RMIClient instance with the given parameters. Validates the input arguments, connects to the RMI server, and initializes components required for communication with the server and updates within the client system.
      Parameters:
      ipAddress - the IP address of the server to connect to; must not be null or empty
      port - the port number of the server; must be within the range [1, 65535]
      uuid - the unique identifier of the client; must not be null
      ui - the user interface implementation to interact with the client
      model - the client-side model representing the application's data structure
      Throws:
      Exception - if any error occurs during connection or initialization
      IllegalArgumentException - if any of the parameters ipAddress, port, or uuid are invalid
      RemoteException - if the server lookup fails

  • Method Details

    • lookUpForServer

      private VirtualServerRMI lookUpForServer(String ipAddress, int port)
      Looks up and retrieves a remote RMI server instance from the specified IP address and port.
      Parameters:
      ipAddress - the IP address of the RMI registry; must not be null or empty
      port - the port number of the RMI registry; must be within the range [0, 65535]
      Returns:
      the VirtualServerRMI instance representing the server retrieved from the RMI registry
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if there is a communication issue with the registry or the server is not bound

      private void run()
      Connects the client to the server with the RMI connection protocol

    • pingServer

      private void pingServer()
      Initiates a periodic task to send a heartbeat (ping) to the server. This method schedules a fixed-rate executor that periodically sends a ping message to the server. The ping task runs at a fixed interval of 5000 milliseconds.

    • enqueueCommunication

      private void enqueueCommunication(ThrowingRunnable runnable)
      Adds a ThrowingRunnable task to the processing queue and ensures any exceptions thrown during its execution are handled appropriately. The method wraps the given task in a Runnable, catches exceptions if they occur, logs a message indicating the server connection is lost, and terminates the application.
      Parameters:
      runnable - the task to be executed, defined as a ThrowingRunnable which can throw exceptions
